def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Int, Solver, Not, sat
    rb_node = Int('rb_node')
    fde_tmp = Int('fde_tmp')
    s = Solver()
    s.add(rb_node != 0)
    s.add(fde_tmp == 0)
    s.add(Not(fde_tmp == 0))
    return s.check() == sat
